feed.title: abox.tools
feed.subtitle: Free image compression, PDF, video, audio and text tools from abox.tools (A Box of Tools). Process files in your browser without processing uploads.

entry.title: How to broadcast voice on a local network
entry.summary: Start a browser voice channel and invite listeners by link or nearby discovery. Direct is the default; an encrypted Cloud relay is available with explicit confirmation.

entry.title: How to receive live voice from nearby people
entry.summary: Open a browser voice pager with password admission and individual speaker controls. Choose Direct or an optional encrypted Cloud relay before hosting.

entry.title: Local Walkie-Talkie
entry.summary: Broadcast voice to up to ten receive-only browsers. Direct local connections or optional Cloud relay, with push to talk, hands-free speech and private group discovery.

entry.title: Voice Oncall
entry.summary: Let up to ten people send live voice to one host browser. Direct local connections or optional Cloud relay, with a pager password, push to talk and moderation.

entry.title: AVIF to JPG
entry.summary: Convert AVIF images to JPG in your browser. Your browser already decodes AVIF, so nothing is uploaded, there is no account, and it works offline. Transparency is filled with a colour you choose.

entry.title: Audio Editor
entry.summary: Play a track backwards, speed it up or slow it down, and make a quiet recording louder. Takes the sound out of a video too. Runs in your browser: nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Audio Trimmer
entry.summary: Play a recording and mark every part worth keeping as it goes past, then save those parts as one file. Sample-exact cuts, no clicks at the joins, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Base64 Encoder & Decoder
entry.summary: Encode and decode Base64 in both alphabets, percent-encode URLs, escape HTML entities, and read hex and backslash escapes. It all runs in your browser - nothing is uploaded, so a token never leaves your machine.

entry.title: Business Profile Preview
entry.summary: See how your Google Business Profile will look before it goes live: the knowledge panel, the phone card and the search result, drawn from the name, category, hours, rating and photo you type. Import an existing listing by pasting it. Download as PNG or SVG. It all happens in your browser.

entry.title: DICOM Viewer
entry.summary: A free DCM file opener: open .dcm scans — CT, MR, X-ray and ultrasound — in your browser, with nothing to install. Window and level, scroll a whole series, measure in millimetres, read every DICOM tag, and see exactly what in the file identifies the patient. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Document Scanner
entry.summary: Turn a phone photo of a page into a straightened, evenly lit PDF. The corners are found for you, the perspective is undone, the shadow is divided out. Runs entirely in your browser: nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: EXIF Viewer & Remover
entry.summary: See the EXIF and GPS data hidden in a photo, edit it, or strip the lot in one click. JPEG, PNG and WebP stay unencoded; AVIF cleaning converts to a new PNG. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Extract Audio from Video
entry.summary: Get the sound out of an MP4, MOV or WebM and save it as a WAV. The video never leaves your machine and its picture is never decoded - the whole job runs in your own browser.

entry.title: GIF Analyzer
entry.summary: Inspect GIF frames, delays, palettes and a byte-by-byte size breakdown in your browser. Check large or slow animations without uploading or changing the file.

entry.title: GIF Maker
entry.summary: Turn JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF images into an animated GIF, free and entirely in your browser. Set the order, the speed and the size. Nothing is uploaded, and it works offline.

entry.title: GIF Splitter
entry.summary: Extract GIF frames as PNGs, a ZIP or one sprite sheet in your browser. Keep transparency and save frame delays in a separate timing list. No upload.

entry.title: GIF to MP4
entry.summary: Turn an animated GIF into an MP4 in your browser, at a fraction of the size. Every frame keeps the GIF's own timing; nothing is resampled. H.264 in an MP4, the file every platform takes. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: HEIC to JPG
entry.summary: Convert iPhone HEIC and AVIF photos to JPG in your browser. The decoder runs on your own machine: nothing is uploaded, no account, works offline, and the date and camera details can come along. The metadata checkbox and metadata preview apply only to HEIC; AVIF metadata is always left out.

entry.title: Hash & Checksum
entry.summary: Work out the MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512 of any file and compare it with the checksum the download page published. The file is read in your browser and never uploaded, at any size.

entry.title: Height Comparison Chart
entry.summary: Compare heights side by side. Add a man, a woman, a boy, a girl and objects — a door, a window, a whiteboard, a vending machine — in centimetres or feet and inches, and download the chart as a PNG or an SVG. It is drawn in your browser.

entry.title: How to make a big number feel familiar
entry.summary: Make a huge number understandable with books, water, stars, sand and counting time. Choose familiar landmarks, keep the assumptions in view and watch the number grow.

entry.title: How to share a browser tab live without an extension
entry.summary: Show a browser tab to an approved viewer. Choose Direct on a reachable local network or an optional encrypted Cloud relay. No extension or remote control.

entry.title: How to stitch two tables without losing the rows that do not match
entry.summary: Choose a match key, pair rows manually, stack records or merge columns by row order. How to keep unmatched rows, check duplicate matches and export without losing identifiers.

entry.title: ID Photo Maker
entry.summary: Prepare passport or visa photos for supported countries: published sizes, marked crop guidance, head and eye overlays, background checks, printable sheets and JPEG upload presets. Your photo stays in your browser.

entry.title: Image Compressor
entry.summary: Compress a JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF to fit a file-size limit, such as 100 KB or 2 MB. The result aims at or below your target, not an exact byte count. No upload, works offline.

entry.title: Image Layout
entry.summary: Arrange images in a grid or strip with ready-to-use presets. Adjust each picture with pan and zoom, then save one PNG, JPEG or WebP. Free, offline and no upload.

entry.title: Image Redactor
entry.summary: Cover a name, an address or an account number in a photo or screenshot and re-encode the picture, so the hidden pixels are gone from the file rather than sitting under a rectangle. Runs entirely in your browser.

entry.title: Image Resizer
entry.summary: Resize, crop and convert JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF images in your browser. Exact pixels, a percentage, or a long edge - one image or a whole folder. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Image Stacker
entry.summary: Stack photos to reduce noise, remove moving people or make star trails. Align frames and save PNG or JPEG in your browser. RAW files use embedded JPEG previews.

entry.title: Image to Data URI
entry.summary: Turn a PNG, JPEG, SVG or WebP into a data URI you can paste into CSS or HTML. UTF-8 SVGs are percent-encoded rather than base64, so they stay readable and shorter. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
